title: BlackHoleProperties
description: Source-preserving black-hole parameters. Schwarzschild radius is the nonrotating reference radius 2GM/c^2; it is not interchangeable with a spin-dependent Kerr event-horizon radius or a variable visual/accretion-disk extent.

relativeBinarySemimajorAxisAU.description: Relative semimajor axis of the two-body binary in AU; not either component's barycentric semimajor axis.

eccentricity.description: Dimensionless eccentricity of the relative binary orbit.

inclinationDeg.description: Source-reported binary inclination in degrees; does not specify an in-plane orientation or orbital phase.

schwarzschildReferenceRadiusKm.description: Nonrotating reference radius calculated from mass; not a separately measured horizon size.

eventHorizonRadiusKm.description: Spin-dependent horizon radius; null when spin is not sourced.

visualAccretionDiskOuterRadiusKm.description: Variable/renderer-specific visible disk extent; null means no canonical physical boundary is asserted.
